title: Every Heart a Doorway
author: Seanan McGuire
current_text: In 2023, Clay County District Schools, Florida, banned Every Heart a Doorway. In 2023, Duval County Public Schools removed Every Heart a Doorway from school libraries, pending review for upcoming school years.

sources.quote: In 2023, Every Heart a Doorway was banned in Clay County District Schools, Florida and removed from school libraries in Duval County Public Schools, with pending review for upcoming school years.
sources.title: Every Heart a Doorway - Wikipedia

ban_rows.note: Banned in Belarus by addition to the Official List of Publications Harmful to National Interests (Ministry of Information). Decision: 2025-08-04. Country of origin: USA. Documented by PEN Belarus.
